vi: Nhận ra ba engine rất khác nhau (Valkey/Kafka/OpenSearch) dùng cùng một resource `digitalocean_database_cluster` — chỉ khác argument `engine`, học một schema là dùng được ba sản phẩm.

Kỹ năng cấu hình cache/stream/search: Valkey cache với `eviction_policy`, `digitalocean_database_redis_config` tinh chỉnh maxmemory + persistence riêng; Kafka 3-node bắt buộc + `digitalocean_database_kafka_topic` partition/replication; OpenSearch export thêm dashboard `ui_uri`.
Thực hành access control một-token: một PAT điều khiển mọi engine, không IAM-role/federation, credential DO tự quản, secret nằm ngoài `.tf`.
Hiểu khác biệt cache vs stream vs search: Valkey in-memory key/value, Kafka durable event bus 7-day retention delete policy, OpenSearch search/analytics kèm dashboard.
Dọn tài nguyên giá đắt: Kafka 3-node đắt nhất (~$150/mo), cache 1-node rẻ (~$15), OpenSearch 1-node (~$15–30), không pause — destroy sớm để tiết kiệm credit lab.
en: Realize that three very different engines (Valkey/Kafka/OpenSearch) use the same `digitalocean_database_cluster` resource — differing only by `engine`, learn one schema and use all three.

Configure cache/stream/search: Valkey cache with `eviction_policy`, separate `digitalocean_database_redis_config` to tune maxmemory + persistence; Kafka requires 3-node + `digitalocean_database_kafka_topic` with partition/replication; OpenSearch exports extra dashboard `ui_uri`.
Practice one-token access control: a single PAT drives every engine, no IAM-role/federation, credentials managed by DO, secrets live outside `.tf`.
Understand the differences: Valkey is in-memory key/value, Kafka is a durable event bus with 7-day delete retention, OpenSearch is search/analytics with a dashboard.
Clean up expensive resources: Kafka 3-node is priciest (~$150/mo), cache 1-node is cheap (~$15), OpenSearch 1-node is ~$15–30, no pause mode — destroy early to save lab credit.
